title: console(oauth consent): the metadata:write scope from #26550 is shown to the user as the raw string, not as a sentence of what they are granting
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named location, owed by work in flight. Found by the #26464 os-dev report (`6437984964`, out_of_scope item 1, code read, not browser-measured) and confirmed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017, session `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`) reading `origin/main`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #26550

**Business reason:** PR #26550 adds the OAuth scope `metadata:write`, which lets an MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, …) change an environment's metadata. Once it lands, the authorization server advertises it and a client can ask for it. The person who approves that request on the Console consent screen sees the bare string `metadata:write` beside three plain sentences for the other agent scopes. The one scope that lets an agent build in their environment is the only one the screen does not explain.

**Reader who acts:** the lane triage names (`ui/apps/console`).

## Where

At `origin/main`, read 2026-10-27:
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx:274-313`, `describeScope`: cases for `openid`, `profile`, `email`, `offline_access`, `data:read`, `data:write` and `actions:execute`. No case for `metadata:write`, so `default: return scope` renders it raw (`:239`).
- PR #26550 declares `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY` in `packages/spec/src/ai/mcp.zod.ts` (`:170` on its head): one consent sentence per `McpOauthScope`, keyed by the scope so a scope cannot be added without one. The three existing sentences there are the ones the Console hard-codes today.

## Wanted

The Console reads the agent-scope sentences from `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_CONSENT_COPY` (as the `defaultValue` behind its translation keys, or directly), so `metadata:write` gets its sentence and a future scope cannot render raw. Add a translation key for the new sentence in every bundle. A test pins that every `MCP_OAUTH_SCOPES` member renders a sentence and none renders its raw string.

## Also carried here (prose drift below the filing bar, same report item 2)

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json:186` says a token with none of the MCP scopes is refused with `insufficient_scope` "naming all three scopes (data:read, data:write, actions:execute)". After #26550 there are four. Update the clause when the Console half lands, or in #26550's follow-up if that comes first.

Dedupe: open issues and PRs grepped for `describeScope`, `OAuthConsentPage` and `metadata:write` consent: none besides #26464 / #26550 themselves, which leave the Console out of scope.
